name: Aine
source: An angel who lives in the town's church, and whose powers are inferior to other angels'. Aine is always cheerful and kind, though also a little clumsy. She is the vocalist and guitarist of the angel-made band "CaS". Her motto in life is "My happiness is to make other people happy." For some reason, her favorite food is bananas.
